objective: Resolve the single decision-changing OBL-CSTAR-TRANSPORT-1 uncertainty: uniform bit-polynomial evaluation of the unique calibrated degree-D map on U,V, with no hidden connection data.

candidates.title: Low-degree calibrated-map evaluator search
candidates.uncertainty: Can one fixed uniform program reconstruct or evaluate on U,V the unique normalized degree-D=2^a map f:E->C fixed by P->X in poly(lambda,log p) bit cost from exactly the declared source-End(E) interface?
candidates.positive_decision: Send at most one complete typed evaluator route through the frozen independent review; consider implementation only after a later reviewed approval.
candidates.negative_decision: Record only the exact failed route/representation/interface and rerank a distinct structural ingredient; do not close EndRing PKE.
candidates.next_action: Idea Generator authors the zero-run A/B/C and evaluator-only packet; Coordinator snapshots it before review.

ambiguities.question: Does an Omega(D) dense rational-map output bound dispose the evaluator-only challenge?
ambiguities.resolution: No. It applies only to that output representation unless an evaluator-to-dense-map reduction is proved.
ambiguities.basis: The requested output f(U),f(V) has only O(log p) bits; representation and evaluation complexity are separate obligations.

ambiguities.question: Does N>4D uniqueness provide an algorithm?
ambiguities.resolution: No. Treat uniqueness as identifiability and require a separate uniform construction/evaluation algorithm.
ambiguities.basis: BATCH-066c3b retained the singleton fiber but no evaluated transporter.

ambiguities.question: Can a full-path endpoint/P->X check be counted as local chain pruning?
ambiguities.resolution: No. Credit pruning only when the predicate is available on a prefix and has proved soundness, completeness, and cost.
ambiguities.basis: Otherwise recursion still explores the full candidate family before checking.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: A complete typed uniform evaluator with proved bit costs/failure and actual-message recovery, or a precise route-scoped missing theorem exposed by all mandatory controls.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: Retain one named interface/theorem with exact inputs, output, falsifier, and revisit trigger; no automatic repetition.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Resolve routine representation choices prospectively; any material change to input, degree, normalization, output, or assumption creates an additive successor rather than silent reinterpretation.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: Valid J1-J5 composition after immutable producer snapshot and fresh independent review.
peripheral_exclusions: New PKE family or M1/P2 mechanism
Generic EndRing attack or universal lower bound

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Mathematical derivation, source verification, cost accounting, and report/visual rendering.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: A finalist must be polynomial in encoded input length; O(D), O(N), or exponential branching is disqualifying for that finalist but remains a valid scoped finite definition.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One producer; two fresh independent reviewers only after snapshot; archive tasks isolated.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Fourteen complete producer artifacts with at most one finalist or one precisely localized missing interface; no trial execution.
